Class AbstractParameterRenderer<T>

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.swing.agi.message.part.tool.param.AbstractParameterRenderer<T>
Type Parameters:
T - The type of parameter value this renderer handles.
All Implemented Interfaces:
ParameterRenderer<T>
Direct Known Subclasses:
AbstractListParameterRenderer, AgiClassSourceParameterRenderer, FullTextFileCreateRenderer, ObjectToStringParameterRenderer
public abstract class AbstractParameterRenderer<T> extends Object implements ParameterRenderer<T>
Abstract base class for parameter renderers implementing standard context binding and hierarchical composite notifications via valueChanged(Object).

anahata

    • valueChanged

      public void valueChanged(T newValue)
      Authoritatively propagates an updated value:
      • If nested inside a parent renderer, notifies the parent via ParameterRenderer.childValueChanged(ParameterRenderer, Object).
      • If top-level (parentRenderer == null), commits directly to call.setModifiedArgument(paramName, newValue).
      Parameters:
      newValue - The newly updated value.
